description: A walk through the Mare Frigoris quarters, a small lunar building you can enter in first person: lit rooms, sliding doors that open as you approach, windows onto the regolith, a wall control panel (face it and press Enter) and an airlock that depressurises before it lets you out. The HUD shows the room you are in and its air pressure.
name: CVEL: Mare Frigoris quarters, on foot
